meta.source: Prism's own brand, used as the second test brand for Prism: a content studio that turns raw material into complete documents. Styled after the Prism Backlog artifact (palette, Bricolage Grotesque / IBM Plex type, spectrum motif). Values are invented and checked for contrast. Print sizes are given in px at 96 dpi (1pt = 1.333px).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen ground: social posts, carousel panels, blog headers (light palette), email page, deck content slides. Dark: the dark ground for dark posts and dark slides.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Print page ground for sheets, brochures and case studies (print on white, never bg). Also card, stats and callout fills on bg. Dark: cards on the dark ground.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Headings, titles, bold text, the logo ink. 15.2:1 on bg, 16.5:1 on surface; dark 15.3:1.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Running text, list items, lede. 9.6:1 on bg; dark 11.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, stat labels, meta lines, eyebrows, quote attributions. 5.5:1 on bg, 5.1:1 on soft; dark 7.1:1.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Folios, chart axis ticks and base (non-highlighted) chart bars only. FLAG: 3.2:1 on surface, 2.95:1 on bg, below text contrast; never running text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card and stats borders, table rules, row dividers (1px).

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Band fill, chip fill, code fill, the gap track behind a spectrum bar.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand hue: the one accent word in a title, stat figures, links, buttons, check marks, icons on cards, the highlighted chart series. 6.1:1 on bg; dark 7.1:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (buttons). 6.6:1; dark 7.1:1.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted callout fill and the title wash (radial, accent-tint to the ground). accent text on it 5.8:1; dark 5.9:1.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Tinted callout border and link underline.

tokens.name: hue-1
tokens.usage: Spectrum band 1 (red). Fills and rules only: spectrum strips, the section rule of sections 1, 5, 9. 4.4:1 on surface; dark 6.2:1, the logo red.

tokens.name: hue-2
tokens.usage: Spectrum band 2 (amber). Fills and rules only. 3.6:1 on surface, 3.3:1 on bg (graphics only); dark 8.7:1, the logo amber.

tokens.name: hue-3
tokens.usage: Spectrum band 3 (green). Fills and rules only. 3.4:1 on surface, 3.2:1 on bg (graphics only); dark 8.5:1.

tokens.name: hue-4
tokens.usage: Spectrum band 4 (blue). Fills and rules only. 4.7:1 on surface; dark 7.0:1, the logo blue.

tokens.name: hue-1-text
tokens.usage: Text in the hue of band 1: section numbers and code labels (e.g. F1) beside a hue-1 rule. 5.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: hue-2-text
tokens.usage: Text in the hue of band 2. 5.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: hue-3-text
tokens.usage: Text in the hue of band 3. 4.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: hue-4-text
tokens.usage: Text in the hue of band 4. 6.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 and the highlighted bars. An alias: resolve it.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (alias).

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (alias).

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (alias).

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 and every non-highlighted bar (alias).

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines.

tokens.name: dark-deep
tokens.usage: Darkest stop of the dark-slide and dark-card gradient (dark-deep, dark-card, dark-high, top-left to bottom-right).

tokens.name: dark-card
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the dark gradient; the CtaCard ground in every theme, under the cta-card background image.

tokens.name: dark-high
tokens.usage: Lightest stop of the dark gradient. dark-fg on it 11.7:1.

tokens.name: dark-fg
tokens.usage: Headings and text on the dark card and dark slides in every theme (the card is dark in both themes).

tokens.name: dark-muted
tokens.usage: Eyebrows and notes on the dark card and dark slides. 5.5:1 on dark-high, 7.1:1 on dark-deep.

tokens.name: dark-accent
tokens.usage: The accent word and button fill on the dark card and dark slides.

tokens.name: header-light-1
tokens.usage: Blog header, light palette: ground.

tokens.name: header-light-2
tokens.usage: Blog header, light palette: radial wash behind the title.

tokens.name: header-deep-1
tokens.usage: Blog header, deep palette: ground (dark-deep).

tokens.name: header-deep-2
tokens.usage: Blog header, deep palette: radial wash behind the title.

tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: Screen surround behind sheet, brochure and post previews. Never printed.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Masthead and title-slide title (33pt in print). Max 18ch, at most one accent word.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section heading h2 (15pt) over its 3px hue rule.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Prism builds every format from one approved draft.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The label above a title or heading, uppercase, muted, after a spectrum chip.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: h4 labels and detail headings, uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code labels (F1, D3) in the section's hue-N-text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Figure, chart and table captions; folio.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Inside chips and between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Between a heading and its rule; list item gap.

tokens.name: space
tokens.usage: Paragraph and list spacing; card padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks (the backlog's column gap).

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading.

tokens.name: page-x
tokens.usage: Print side margin (0.75in); social safe inset at 1080px is 88px (see Outputs).

tokens.name: page-top
tokens.usage: Print top margin after page one (0.75in).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Code labels, kind tags, small images.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, email buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, callouts, stats, the CtaCard.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero image and figures.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and the spectrum chip's ends (half its height in SVG).

shadow.note: Flat brand: borders, not shadows. One shadowed image per piece at most.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The one standout image, usually the hero.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A sheet or post on the desk in screen previews. Never printed.
